title: commercial opportunities - u.s. embassy in egypt
paragraphs: every year, the u.s. commercial service helps thousands of companies export goods and services worth billions of dollars. let us help you find the best opportunities for your business in egypt. the trade leads database contains pre-screened, time-sensitive leads and government tenders gathered through our office. for more information and to submit letters of interest and quotes, please send an email to office.cairo@trade.gov . note: only american suppliers/equipment will be considered.
